saw.short: GTA VI's launch week: estimated 24.5m units in first-day sales
saw.headline: *GTA VI’s launch week*: an estimated 24.5 million units by day one
saw.what: Sensor Tower estimates pre-orders plus first-day sales at more than 24.5 million units, around $2.36 billion, per BBC News. About three quarters are on PS5. Rockstar and Take-Two have given no sales figures and called demand “unprecedented”. Metro’s reviewer reported no obvious server issues at launch.
saw.why: The week’s biggest shared moment, from leaks to launch. All the sales figures are estimates.

saw.short: Robert Pattinson is the next Bond, and Pierce Brosnan welcomes him
saw.headline: *Robert Pattinson* is the next Bond, and Pierce Brosnan welcomes him
saw.what: Amazon MGM announced Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond on Monday, per Deadline and Variety, with Denis Villeneuve directing. Pierce Brosnan posted “Welcome to the world of Bond. You are going to be magnificent”, and George Lazenby also welcomed him, per Metro. No release date has been announced.
saw.why: The biggest casting reveal of the year. The reaction from past Bonds kept it going.
saw.source: Deadline, 16 Nov; Variety, 16 Nov; Metro, 19 Nov

saw.short: I'm A Celebrity's first week: a twist, a late arrival and a lower launch audience
saw.headline: *I’m A Celebrity’s first week*: a twist, a late arrival and a lower launch audience
saw.what: AJ Odudu’s day-one “elimination” wasn’t real: Radio Times says she joined late arrival Leigh Francis as he entered camp on Wednesday. Metro reports Monday’s launch had 4.8 million overnight viewers, the lowest launch overnight for the show, against 6.6 million last year, with streaming adding more than a million. These are Metro’s figures.
saw.why: A week of talking points. The audience figure is worth watching for ITV.

saw.short: Early System1 scores put M&S, Morrisons, Sainsbury's and Aldi on 5.9 stars
saw.headline: Early System1 scores: *M&S, Morrisons, Sainsbury’s and Aldi on 5.9 stars*
saw.what: System1’s early Christmas ad leaderboard, with data to 12 Nov, has M&S “The Home of Christmas” on 5.9 stars, Morrisons and Sainsbury’s on 5.9, Aldi on 5.9 and Waitrose’s “The Perfect Gift 2” on 5.6, per 365 Retail. Supermarkets take seven of the top 12. John Lewis isn’t in the top 12. Scores are early.
saw.why: Christmas ads were the season’s big talking point. Early data is a guide, not a result.

saw.short: Pochettino's first Man Utd training session was filmed by a drone
saw.headline: *Pochettino’s first Man Utd training session* was filmed by a drone
saw.what: BBC Sport reports a drone operator filmed 12 minutes of Pochettino’s first full-squad training session and posted it to YouTube, saying it was legal. Metro says United are 18th and winless in eight. His first game is at Liverpool on Sunday, kick-off 4.30pm per BBC.
saw.why: A new boss, a viral clip and a big Sunday game. Football fans will fill feeds.

saw.short: KPop Demon Hunters announces nine UK and Ireland dates for 2027
saw.headline: *KPop Demon Hunters* announces nine UK and Ireland dates for 2027
saw.what: Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour has nine UK and Ireland dates in October 2027, including Glasgow OVO Hydro, Manchester AO Arena and two nights at London’s O2, per Radio Times. General sale is at 10am on Friday 20 Nov. Radio Times is the only source we have.
saw.why: A family-friendly fan frenzy with a ticket queue. Good one for the Friday feed.

platform.short: Instagram lets you edit Stories for 15 minutes after posting
platform.headline: Instagram lets you *edit Stories* for 15 minutes after posting
platform.what: Instagram says users can edit a published Story for up to 15 minutes, per Social Media Today. It also adds easier multi-image selection, a new sticker selector and more colour gradients. Rollout dates and countries aren’t stated.
platform.why: Fewer deleted-and-reposted Stories. Check the feature’s rollout in the app.

platform.short: Threads tests upvoted Q&A in live chats
platform.headline: Threads tests *upvoted Q&A* in live chats
platform.what: Threads is testing a Q&A option in live chats, where hosts collect questions and participants vote on which to ask, per Social Media Today. All participants can read the responses. It is a test with selected live chats only.
platform.why: A way to run brand Q&As on Threads. Test only for now.

platform.short: Snapchat will show who your mutual friends are
platform.headline: Snapchat will show *who your mutual friends are*
platform.what: Snapchat says profiles will list friends you have in common, where it currently shows only a count, per Social Media Today. It is opt-in and both users must opt in. The launch date isn’t stated.
platform.why: More social-graph detail on Snapchat. Opt-in, so reach will be limited.
